dct_description_sm: Temperature data collected in borehole GDC-05 sealed with a flexible and impermeable liner during an active distributed temperature sensing test. The test consisted of measuring the background temperature for 30 minutes before the composite fiber optic cable is heated at a constant power output of 7.5 W/m for 10 hours. The background data is used to calculate the temperature difference above background presented in this dataset.
